role: director plan; builder copies the named exemplar components literally from work/replica/editorial-chiefofstaff/index.html (josh.*) and work/replica/editorial-vibecoding/index.html (mich.*)

layout_targets.variant: M (reference B-like). REFERENCE-ANALYSIS section 6 says pick one variant per video and do not average; M is chosen because the HUD power strip, the clay cube takeover and the gate's 8.0 s static budget are reference B's, and because v1 failed the static gate at 9.92 s / 30 s.
layout_targets.also_vs_default_blend: S 85.6% vs default 72+/-8 (outside: by design, M variant); G 11.6% vs 25+/-8 (outside, M variant); F 2.8% vs 4 (inside). STYLE.md's '3-5 takeovers' prose is overridden by the measured M numbers (1.5-2.3 / min).
layout_targets.seam: hard edge at y960; face cam assets/face_half.mp4 cover-fit y960-1920; no fade, no border
layout_targets.first_frame: graphics present and on-topic at frame 0 (Claude spark + 'CLAUDE · NEW IN BETA'), first change 0.10 s, first caption 0.00 s

gate.plan: every split beat has a continuous motion carrier: clips, typing, scrubbers, counters, cube yaw, cursor glides. The reference B grid drift (about 5 levels at 0.75 px per 0.1 s sample) and the card slow push s(t)=1+0.0052(t-t_in) are kept for fidelity, but they sit below the gate's 0.35 mean-luma threshold, so do not count them as carriers. The longest planned gap between discrete changes is 1.42 s (37.8-39.22, covered by two playing renders). Clip windows were checked for motion: the README film wall at media 0-2.06 moves; huashu-film at media 6-11 is nearly static (diff 0.4-1.0), so b18a now starts it at 13.0 (kinetic section).

checks.verdict: NEAR (slow delivery: 'Claude' 0.66 s, 'did' 0.76 s, 'video' 0.68 s; the two longest chips were split, max 1.94 -> 1.62 s)

checks.metric: visible changes / s incl. clip-internal shot changes
checks.verdict: ABOVE band by design: v1 failed the static gate, and clip cuts are not editor changes; do not add more discrete changes

layout_targets.caption_note: 4-word chunks (8%) appear only where Chase speaks too fast for a >= 0.40 s 3-word chip: 'SO IF YOU WANT' 0.0, 'TO GET YOUR HANDS' 0.45, 'IT HEAD TO HEAD' 35.8, 'A LITTLE BIT BETTER' 39.2, 'AND IT WILL BE' 46.3. M never shows 4, J shows 1%; rule 'never > 4' holds. Plan checker split the two longest chips ('CLAUDE MOTION DESIGN' 1.94 s -> 'CLAUDE MOTION' + 'DESIGN'; 'VIDEO AI GENERATOR' 1.90 s -> 'VIDEO AI' + 'GENERATOR', which also lands GENERATOR on strike 1): mean 2.75 -> 2.66 (M 2.63), 1-word 7% -> 10% (M 12%).
layout_targets.stats_method: visible changes = planned action times + layout cuts (F excluded), merged within 0.35 s like the donor detector; clip-internal shot changes are NOT counted (they add roughly 5-8 more, so the real rate will sit near the top of the band). Entrances = planned new on-screen elements / non-F seconds.
